تستغفلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْفِلُوا (tastaḡfilū) /tas.taɣ.fi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# تُسْتَغْفَلُوا (tustaḡfalū) /tus.taɣ.fa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
